items.question: What divine attributes identify Padmā as the supreme embodiment of prosperity?
premises: Padmā is named as the lotus-goddess.
She is described as abiding in the lotus.
She is identified with prosperity itself.
She is characterized as supremely eminent.
She is described as holding the auspicious lotus.
items.inference: Padmā is affirmed as the supreme personification of prosperity endowed with lotus-associated divine attributes.
uncertainties: Whether the verse functions as direct invocation, identification, or descriptive praise within the surrounding dialogue is not fully determined from this line alone.
items.plain_english: Padmā, the lotus-abiding goddess, is prosperity itself, supremely exalted and holding the auspicious lotus.
